mentions.name: Librario
mentions.description: A simple book metadata aggregation API written in Go. It fetches book information from multiple sources, intelligently merges everything, and stores the results in a PostgreSQL database for future lookups, serving as a comprehensive book data source for booksellers, libraries, and book-related services. Currently a pre-alpha build with comprehensive documentation written; code planned for GitHub under an AGPL license.
mentions.problem: Book information is scattered across multiple sources; the API consolidates and merges it into one comprehensive dataset, solving a problem the author personally has.
mentions.audience: Online booksellers, libraries, book-related startups, bookworms, and more.
mentions.source_excerpt: Librario is a simple book metadata aggregation API written in Go. It fetches information about books from multiple sources, merges everything intelligently, and then saves it all to a PostgreSQL database for future lookups.
